source_scope_verdict.together_shell: White editorial case-study frame, narrow reading column, serif narrative headline, sans utility labels and long-form proof sequencing.
source_scope_verdict.spade_brand_system: Green tonal family, large geometric sans headline, mono data labels, cut/rail measurement language, contour object and transaction evidence attachment.
source_scope_verdict.platform_ui: Sticky navigation, contact action, mobile menu and responsive container behavior.
source_scope_verdict.case_study_presentation: Sparse explanation followed by oversized media/proof canvases and numbered focus chapters.
source_scope_verdict.content_examples: Transaction, merchant, location, latency and financial-data examples; content is not portable copy.

layout_verdict.outer_shell: Together uses a near-white editorial page; Spade uses alternating white, pale field and dark proof surfaces.
layout_verdict.inner_canvas: Together centers a narrow reading column before wide media; Spade uses full-width instrument canvases with internal measurement relationships.
layout_verdict.core_grammar: sparse explanation → dense evidence → semantic attachment → measured boundary → one protagonist → explicit proof

card_system_verdict: The sources do not support universal cardification. Proof canvases, evidence callouts and narrative sections are distinct container types.
portable_hypothesis: Preserve density rhythm, evidence attachment, measured relationships and limited signals while transforming palette, boundary form, topology, typography proportion and protagonist form.
high_impact_questions: Which exact source values must remain observation-only?
Which trait combinations create identity risk on a single surface?
Which topology relationships are mechanisms versus brand signatures?
Which components are reusable mechanisms versus source-specific motifs?
Which image and motion behaviors remain unverified?
